M06 density follow-up: Codex P2 on PR #999 (branch `codex/run-41514255466-1`). Continue on that branch. apps/web only.

FINDING (`apps/web/src/lib/spatial/galaxy-density-source.ts` ~line 263, `heatmapViewportRequest`): the focus-centred cube (radius 1.5 × the zoom bucket) excludes part of the visible galaxy plane at regional zoom — e.g. focus (0,0,0), distance 10,000 LY, default pitch 0.55 rad: the request ends at Z = 16,384 LY while `galaxyCameraPlanePoint` with the renderer's 0.72-rad FOV puts the top-centre screen ray on the focus plane at Z ≈ 18,653 LY; lower pitches widen the gap. Occupied cells in that strip are never requested although the legend says "Complete".

FIX: derive conservative density bounds from the camera projection and viewport dimensions — project the four viewport corners (and edge midpoints) onto the galactic plane with `galaxyCameraPlanePoint` (apps/web/src/lib/spatial/galaxy-camera.ts) using the real FOV/aspect, take the enclosing XZ box, add an overscan margin (e.g. 15 % plus one cell), clamp to the galaxy navigation bounds (`GALAXY_CAMERA_NAVIGATION_BOUNDS_LY`), and bucket the result (snap to the existing step) so cache keys stay stable; Y bounds from the camera elevation ± the vertical radius policy. Rays that miss the plane (shallow pitch) fall back to the navigation bounds on that side. Include those bounds in the query key (already JSON-keyed). The canvas viewport size is available to Explore via `onViewportChange` (merged in M08 #992 if present on main; otherwise take width/height as parameters with a sensible default). Tests: the Codex example (focus origin, 10,000 LY, pitch 0.55, 16:9) must yield max_z ≥ 18,653 LY; shallow pitch falls back to navigation bounds; bucketed keys are stable across small moves; overview still covers the whole galaxy. Amend the existing M06 CHANGES.md entry. Run `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.
